class.name: MultiMeshInstance3D
class.description: [MultiMeshInstance3D] is a specialized node to instance [GeometryInstance3D]s based on a [MultiMesh] resource. This is useful to optimize the rendering of a high number of instances of a given mesh (for example trees in a forest or grass strands).

link.title: Animating thousands of fish with MultiMeshInstance

method.name: find_nearest_visible_instance
method.description: Returns the index of the nearest 3D instance origin within [param max_distance] of [param world_position], or [code]-1[/code] if none was found. Coordinates are in global space. The distance includes the maximum radius, and ties select the lowest index. The search checks only the first [member MultiMesh.visible_instance_count] instances, or all instances when the count is [code]-1[/code]. It requires a valid 3D [member multimesh] and a node inside the scene tree. The method does not perform camera frustum, physics collision, or occlusion tests. [b]Note:[/b] This query is linear in the number of visible instances. Prefer many small [MultiMesh] chunks to one enormous [MultiMesh] when making repeated gameplay queries. Instance indices may change when game code reorders or swaps transforms; do not use them as persistent entity IDs.

members.member: The [MultiMesh] resource that will be used and shared among all instances of the [MultiMeshInstance3D].
